findings.evidence: loadPackCatalog runs Promise.all over loaderOf, and loaderOf awaits read() (a Vite lazy chunk) outside any catch. bundledPackCatalog caches the promise with `bundled ??=`. use-document-catalog.ts calls bundledPackCatalog(webHasher).then(...) with no rejection handler. The daecd29 body lists this as R11 F1 ('one pack index that fails to read rejects the whole cached catalog').
findings.failure_scenario: One chunk fetch that fails, such as a studio tab left open across a redeploy or a flaky network, leaves the cached catalog rejected for the page's life, with an unhandled rejection. The library offers only the basic pack, and catalog.resolve never runs, so an opened document whose first-party shapes were saved without geometry (autosave, examples) draws them unresolved. Credits and the save also lose the catalog's sources. This is an FR-LIB-009 defect, not cosmetic.
